features.name: nsw_vic_price_diff
features.description: Difference in electricity price between New South Wales and Victoria.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the tree model to split on the relative price difference between the two regions, capturing inter-regional market dynamics.

features.name: nsw_vic_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of electricity demand in New South Wales to Victoria.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of demand imbalance, helping the model identify periods where one region disproportionately drives overall demand.

features.name: high_demand_period
features.description: Indicator for periods where both New South Wales and Victoria experience high electricity demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a direct boolean split for tree models to isolate systemic high-load events.

features.name: price_demand_interaction_nsw
features.description: Interaction term between price and demand in New South Wales.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the non-linear relationship between price and demand, highlighting periods of high revenue or market stress.

features.name: transfer_direction_magnitude
features.description: Absolute deviation of power transfer from the neutral midpoint.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the intensity of power flow regardless of direction, providing a clear threshold for high-transfer states.

features.name: is_peak_period
features.description: Indicator for typical peak hours based on the period feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups continuous time periods into a discrete categorical bucket, simplifying splits for time-of-day effects.

features.name: vic_price_spike
features.description: Indicator for unusually high electricity prices in Victoria.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates extreme price events in Victoria, allowing the model to treat them as a distinct regime.

features.name: nsw_price_spike
features.description: Indicator for unusually high electricity prices in New South Wales.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates extreme price events in New South Wales, providing a direct boolean feature for anomaly detection.

features.name: demand_imbalance
features.description: Absolute difference in electricity demand between New South Wales and Victoria.
features.expected_model_benefit: Quantifies the magnitude of demand mismatch between regions, which may correlate with power transfer requirements.

features.name: transfer_efficiency
features.description: Assesses the efficiency of power transfer between NSW and VIC based on demand and price differentials.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantic evaluation of how well the grid is balancing load and cost, capturing complex operational states.

features.name: market_stress_index
features.description: Evaluates the overall stress on the electricity market considering combined demand and price levels across both regions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple continuous signals into a single holistic risk score, useful for identifying critical market conditions.

features.name: seasonal_demand_shift
features.description: Estimates the seasonal shift in demand patterns based on the date and period features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures long-term temporal trends and seasonal variations that affect baseline demand levels.
